svg.text: DOMAIN 4: CONVERSATIONAL RAG & GROUNDED CITATION EVIDENCE

g.text: UserQuery → VectorRagService → ANN Top-K (Cosine ≥ 0.65) → Grounded Context
Every factual assertion in the AssistantResponse is bound to a GroundedCitation entity.
1. :grounds (TextPassageChunk → GroundedCitation): Anchors citation to immutable chunk text.
2. :citesEvidence (AssistantResponse → GroundedCitation): Attaches evidence tags to response text.
3. :wasDerivedFrom (AssistantResponse → TextPassageChunk): W3C PROV-O data lineage tracking.

svg.text: DOMAIN 5: GOVERNANCE, AUDIT LINEAGE & BPMN 2.0 WORKFLOW (PROV-O)

g.text: Restoring version N does not prune intermediate states (> N). Snapshot N is cloned into
a newly advanced version M = max(versions) + 1, creating an unbroken audit lineage.
